subject: Forensic Science
method: Local OCR cross-check of uploaded original scanned question-paper PDFs at 2.2x render scale against the 300 staged English stems and four-option texts. This is a transcription screening aid, not human visual proofread and not permission to set source_verified=true.

status.note: All question text is present in OCR corpus at high token overlap; four questions are prioritized for visual inspection because OCR token coverage is below 98%. Do not treat this automated metric as a verified visual proofreading count.
